note: ADR-0011 §3.2 first bars. A level-detecting gain control with no look-ahead: neutral exactness, steady-state neutrality, the attack and sustain gains on a tone burst and on its decay, and independence from level are measured; the figures are the ones the first run printed with headroom for other compilers. THD is not a bar: the gain changes over 2 ms or more and is flat on a steady tone.
